# The Code Editor

#### Course: Build your First Web App with React

## The Code Editor

The editor takes up the main area on the right. It shows whichever file you've selected in the Explorer. You'll see the filename as a tab at the top — for example, App.jsx.

When you first open a lesson, App.jsx will already have some default starter code like this:

![The Code Editor](data:image/png;base64,)

This is a placeholder code. When a lesson tells you to replace it, clear it out and write your own code — that's the starting point for every exercise.

##### How does it work?

Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
